axis_selection: The human instructed the agent to select its own axis. PRUNE was selected because R0 has 2,171 dots at 2 < d_catalogue <= 3 px; a non-PRUNE child cannot satisfy the brief's >=3 px hard constraint without adding a second, confounded PRUNE edit. PRUNE is the explicit exception.

p3px.evidence_class: MODEL (prior registry projection, not a live score)

p4px.evidence_class: MODEL (prior registry projection, not a live score)

predictions_are: MODEL, not scores; any live absolute delta < 0.01 is no evidence
treatment: For each value, remove every R0 dot at d_catalogue <= threshold_px; hold N=37,654; add the same number from the original H19-5 support at d_catalogue > threshold_px using exact greedy expected-DTI marginal gain. All other settings and the fixed physical-field ranking recipe are unchanged.
refill_ranking_basis: Exact iterative marginal expected-DTI gain via vendor/gems57/metric.py and scripts/build_prune_variants.py::select_exact_marginal_dti_add; candidate pool is the original H19-5 binary support outside the threshold; fixed label-free physical field across all variants; no isolated-pixel shortcut or random tie score
physical_field: label-free four-line physical field from scripts/build_prune_variants.py: surface scarp, subsurface potential-field, strain/seismic, and hydrothermal lines; all single-channel canaries must be <= 0.90 before the field is used

variants.hypothesis: Extending R0's exclusion from 300 m to 320 m removes a narrow fringe of catalogue-adjacent potential-field side-lobes while the fixed-count refill retains detections on independently corroborated H19-5 line support.
Extending the collar to 370 m may begin to remove genuine secondary splays that sit just beyond the kernel radius; exact marginal refill is predicted to recover only part of that lost credit.

A 430 m collar, slightly wider than the reported 400 m GeoDAWN line spacing, will remove some real range-front step-fault/relay splays, so this upper bracket is expected to lose live DTI at fixed count.

report_only_not_gates: catalogue hide-and-recover PROXY with withheld-positive count and 95% CI
